phases.name: Foundation
phases.notes: Form focus. Starting weights only. No vest yet. Day C optional from month 2.

phases.name: Load Progression
phases.notes: Increase weight when 3×10 feels easy. Introduce vest on bodyweight movements in Day C. Wrist weights on treadmill walks.

phases.name: Volume + Stamina
phases.notes: 4th set on main compound lifts. 20 min continuous jog at 8–9 km/h. Single-leg progressions.

phases.name: Advanced
phases.notes: Tempo work, single-leg variants, vest combinations, sustained 30 min jog at 10 km/h.
